chat.t: Excuse me.
Hello.
[Sent a gift and message]

o: Oh, what's this about?

chat.t: You've finally shown up.
You are not Freya, yet you fell for this.

o: What, I got tricked?
...Hey. No matter how bad it is, comparing me to Freya is too much!

chat.t: The level of intelligence is not a critical matter, so let's move on. Anyway, welcome.
I have something to say.

o: No. Go back.
No doubt you want me to do your chores because you're too lazy.
Or you want me to buy you a giant bread again.

chat.t: I was actually thinking of trading our next chore shifts.

o: Boss, I am on my way.
...But where are you?

chat.t: In the restroom.
I will be out soon.

o: Agh, what the hell?

chat.t: My cognitive module estimates a 92.7% probability that you went to the restroom to sniff it.
Typical {player}. You never deviate from my expectations.

o: I just really had to use the bathroom. No misunderstandings, please.
Who told you to start babbling like you hit post-nut clarity?

chat.t: So you did go. Pervert.

o: Shut up, restroom self-pleasurer.

chat.t: Well, anyway, because of that concern...
I have had a lot on my mind lately.
Like what the meaning of life is.

o: So, what do you want to do about it?

chat.t: I am currently thinking.

o: While doing what?

chat.t: While eating a thick, long, giant bread.

o: She stole another bread before I even realized it.

lines.t: Hideout
What the? I thought you said you were in the restroom.
No one's here... By the way, what is this smell?
Something slightly sour yet fragrant...
Whoa! You startled me!
Why are you so surprised?
Wouldn't anyone be surprised?
I would not be. As you can see, my body is like this.
...That's a rather unsettling answer.
If you have nothing to say, I'm leaving.
Ah, it is nothing else, but...
Why do we live?
Wh-What? What's this all of a sudden?
I came here because you said you'd trade shifts, not to talk about philosophy.
Just because I sent a 'gift' message, {player} came all this way.
Perhaps we live to receive gifts from someone.
...Did you eat something weird? Did you swallow moldy bread?
That thought suddenly occurred to me.
Indeed, that very day not too long ago.
The exact moment we left the Panoticon together.
While I was thinking I was doing something 'bad' that I had never experienced before, a sharp, thrilling shiver ran through my chest.
A thrilling shiver ran through my chest.
Yes. It was a sensation I had never felt before in my life.
So recently, I have been trying various new things to bring back that sensation.
But I have not been able to perfectly replicate it yet.
This girl is just talking to herself again...
While I was reflecting on that sensation, a certain concern arose.
Why do we live? And where do we go?
Did she hit her head somewhere? Her brain is as empty as her body now.
...You caught me.
...Huh?
Actually, I have no memory of my past.
I do not even know how I was created. I have just been living day by day.
I suddenly started wondering if it is fine to keep living like this... and what the meaning of my life is.
...Wait, did I just become the bad guy here?!
It felt the same as usual, though.
Sigh, seriously...
Anyway, anyone can wonder about the meaning of life. What does it matter if you have memories or not?
It was just some meaningless rambling.
However, Freya has no thoughts, and Lumina has too many useless thoughts.
So, the only person worth talking to was {player}.
You don't have any friends, do you?
This is why I said it feels the same as usual.
Anyway, since you came to listen to my nonsense, I will do your share of cleaning for a day next time.
Are you sure? Even if it means giving up your precious nap time?
Of course. Whether I clean or a robot vacuum does it, it is basically the same.
...Then you do all the cleaning from now on.
...I should not have said that. That is so typical of {player}.
Yawn...
I am getting sleepy now... goodbye...
...She's acting a bit strange today.
What on earth did she do in the bathroom to think like that...
By the way, if it's a sour yet sweet smell... Ah!!!!

chat.t: When on earth are you coming?

o: Hang on, hang on.
Buying ingredients.

chat.t: Ingredients? What ingredients all of a sudden?

o: You'll find out soon anyway.

chat.t: What kind of trouble are you trying to cause this time?
Well, since you'll be late...
I'll close my eyes for a bi...
...nd do thaaat

o: ...Did you fall asleep already?
Hey, Theta.
Freya and Lumina are complaining that the kitchen is a mess.
I did everything from prep to cleanup, are you seriously doing this to me?
Don't you have anything to say to me?????

chat.t: The most core part of a Mont Blanc is the process of putting it in your mouth to please your tongue.
In other words, I was responsible for the most important part of cooking.
Anyway, it was fun.
This too will surely become a precious memory that we can look back on and talk about with a smile.

o: Don't change the subject.
Come do the dishes, you slacker bot.

chat.t: Since I am not a bot, I must decline simple repetitive tasks.

o: Seriously, you have no conscience.

lines.t: Hideout
It is the smell of blueberries, cranberries, and cheddar cheese.
Impressive.
This is nothing.
Anyway, what kind of sudden whim—or should I say sudden wealth—possessed you to get these ingredients?
Could it be, a hidden emergency fund...
Uh-uh, it's not like that. I have my reasons.
Reasons?
You like bread, don't you?
Realizing that only now, I am deeply concerned about {player}'s observation skills.
Quiet. Let's make some bread together.
Why all of a sudden...
How long are you going to keep stealing?
Every time the Bakery Owner chases us with a bread knife, it scares me to death.
That is because you run away too slowly.
Am I your punching bag?
It is not criticism, but a fact.
Sigh, forget I asked.
Anyway... try to find the meaning of your life in the bread you like so much.
How long are you going to keep pondering while enjoying yourself alone in the bathroom?
It was somewhat interesting at first, but now it's just the same old routine and I'm tired of it.
Setting aside my bathroom life for now, I never thought of such an approach... however.
I have never actually made bread myself.
It's all about experience.
As you build it up, it gets bigger and harder.
Like a Campagne?
Right, right. And who knows? Maybe you have a knack for making bread.
If so, it'll be a big help when we're starving because we're broke.
I wonder if this is actually meaningful. We can just steal bread anyway.
No, I told you to stop stealing...
Anyway, look through this recipe book. You'll never know until you try.
Mont Blanc.
<bouten>This is it!</bouten>
What's with you all of a sudden?
Campagne is good, but Mont Blanc is even better.
You're starting with a hard one all of a sudden. Are you going to be okay?
Why not give it a shot.
That's not how you put it in!
Then... how?
Here, it says to squeeze it deep into the hole.
If you put it in too shallowly, the pure white cream will overflow outside the hole.
What are you even looking at?
I'm starting to think of something else.
See, it is written in the recipe book as well. Grip it firmly, press the center hard, and push it in.
When filling it, they say you must adjust your fingertips so the pressure does not shift to one side.
Whoa, you're suddenly a master patissier.
...I am not at that level yet. Well, anyway...
Since it is ready, shall we eat?
Mmm...
What's the matter?
There is no deep chestnut aroma.  The cream is just light, and the meringue is... mushy.
This, this is...!
My Mont Blanc... is not like this!
With the first bite, the sweet whipped cream tickles the throat,  immediately followed by the rich lingering taste of chestnut...
How ecstatic it is when it fills your mouth!
To think that the sublime structural aesthetics of Mont Blanc have been ruined like this...!
Oh, you're completely an expert now.
This is... an insult to Mont Blanc!
We must make it again.  I cannot hold my head high in front of Mont Blanc like this.
...Fine, do whatever you want.

In the end, I couldn't break Theta's stubbornness,
and dozens of Mont Blancs (or things claiming to be) were made in our place.
This taste is...!!
Yes!  This is the taste!
Ugh. Did you finally pull it off?
I've eaten so many Mont Blancs that I feel like throwing up just looking at them now...
Mmm... it is delicious.
I want to keep... eating like this.
Fine, you eat them all...
Thank you.
Doing what?
Today, I learned something good.
I will never forget this.
At first, I wondered why we were doing this.
Now, I think I understand a little.
Thank you for your hard work today.
Well, then.
Wait!
Are you seriously trying to dump all the dishes on me like this???
At least help clean up before you go!!
Tch. You caught me.

chat.t: Hey.
Are you busy?

o: Yeah, I'm busy.

chat.t: You are not busy at all. Come on out.
The super-limited special Mont Blanc sold only 5 a day at the 4th Avenue Bakery.

o: Lining up before opening? Is this really worth waiting for...

chat.t: The 4th Avenue Bakery opens at 5 AM.
Setting up a tent and waiting in front of the shop increases the chances.
A tent, drinking water, winter gear, simple games to play when bored, and snacks.
I prepared everything.
Just bring yourself.

o: Try being this diligent in your everyday life, too.
And why don't you just steal that one?

chat.t: I do not steal Mont Blanc. That would be an insult to Mont Blanc.

o: You insult other bread all the time, what are you even talking about?

chat.t: Who am I... Where am I...
I opened my eyes to see... a white ceiling.

o: It must be our Hideout.

chat.t: Ah, I fell asleep, didn't I?

o: Just try falling asleep again. I'll leave you behind.

chat.t: I am fully charged now. Thank you for bringing me to my room.

o: Are you really grateful?

chat.t: For now.

o: It's my fault for even talking to a screw-loose girl like you.

chat.t: My screws are not loose. I undergo regular maintenance.

o: ...Anyway,
Why did you accept that club president position earlier? It must be a hassle.

chat.t: It is a hassle.
So, as the president, I just gave the order to disband the Dessert Club.

o: Why are you disbanding a perfectly fine club?

chat.t: Because they will rebel anyway, kick me out, and do whatever they want on their own.

o: ...She always uses her brain for the strangest things.

lines.t: Downtown Intersection
In the end, I was dragged out by Theta at four in the morning.
I'm sleepy...
Because of you, I had to part with my bed...
Weren't you awake anyway?
We have arrived at the 4th Avenue Bakery.
For your information, this place is also good at cream cheese baguettes topped with cilantro.
What kind of bizarre food is that? I've never even heard of it.
Well, anyway...  There are many tents already waiting here.
Everyone is doing all this just to eat a single piece of bread?
Here, I brought a tent as well.
Just how crazy are you about Mont Blanc...
They said it opens at five, but the line was so long that we had to wait much longer...
Station Front Street
Now, time to finally lay eyes on it...!
Huh?  Dessert Club Member 1
Mont Blanc?  Dessert Club Member 2
It is my turn. Move aside, please.
What are you talking about? We got here first!  Dessert Club Member 1
Yeah! We packed up our tent first!  Dessert Club Member 2
What are you talking about?
I saw it with my own eyes. I was 0.001 seconds faster.
Anyone can say that!  Dessert Club Member 1
We've been lining up since before this shop even existed!  Dessert Club Member 2
You are impossible to reason with.
What do you think Mont Blanc is?
Hmm...  Dessert Club Member 1
U-Uh... well, that's...  Dessert Club Member 2
To think you cannot answer such a simple question right away. You are all pathetic.
To me, Mont Blanc is...   the heart.
Mont Blanc is the greatest gift born from craftsmanship and sweetness.
Ahem... that is indeed a perfect answer, but...  Dessert Club Member 1
Should we just let it go?  Dessert Club Member 1
No way! What are you saying!  Dessert Club Member 2
Anyway, just yield it to us!  Dessert Club Member 2  Bzzzt!
I cannot yield to someone who has no love for Mont Blanc.
Tch. I guess we have no choice.  Dessert Club Member 1
I didn't want to resort to this method.  Dessert Club Member 2
Since words won't work, is it violence?  Why don't you show me that 'sincerity' of yours.
Argh! She's strong!  Dessert Club Member 1
These guys... just how many Mont Blancs did they eat to be this tough?!  Dessert Club Member 2
Tch, frustrating...  Dessert Club Member 1
Frustrating as it is... we will yield the Mont Blanc.  Dessert Club Member 2
Please, our beloved Mont Blanc...  Dessert Club Member 1  enjoy eating it...  *sob*...
It was a good match.
The Mont Blanc will melt sweetly in our mouths.
You mean your mouth, not ours.
Would you like to join our Dessert Club while you're at it?  Dessert Club Member 1
For next week, we decided to eat mint chocolate muffins at the 7th Avenue Bakery.  Dessert Club Member 1
For your information, the time is 4 o'clock.  Dessert Club Member 2
4 o'clock?
4 o'clock will not do.
They will already be sold out by 4.
Why is that?  Dessert Club Member 2
We have memorized the schedule of every single bread in that bakery, though...?  Dessert Club Member 1
Wrong.  That is because you did not apply the 'Bakery Owner Time Difference.'
Bakery Owner's... time difference?  Dessert Club Member 1
That is what I call it, since I have memorized all the bakery patterns.
The Bakery Owners in Humanitas usually finish their work by 3:30 to start selling bread from 4:00.
However, if you line up at 3:30, the Bakery Owners will hide the bread, claiming it is still a draft batch.
Therefore, the open run will only succeed if you visit exactly when each shop displays their bread on the shelves.
What do you mean 'draft' bread? What are you even talking about?
Anyway, the time when the 7th Avenue Bakery owner finishes mentally preparing and puts the bread on display is approximately 3:47.

According to the bread schedule model with the Bakery Owner Time Difference applied, the accuracy is 95% with a margin of error of about 0.27%. Assuming there are 200 daily visitors to the store, around that time...
*cough* *cough*... Y-You win.  Dessert Club Member 2
We are no match for you.  Dessert Club Member 2
Theta... were you always this diligent??
I am lazy by nature. I just put in a brief effort to find the way to be lazy for the longest period of time.
To think you do not even know when the bread comes out. You are disqualified as members of the Dessert Club.
W-We will reflect on our actions...!  Dessert Club Member 1
We will serve you as our president.  Dessert Club Member 2  Please lead us to the world of sweetness!
Being a president...  is a position that comes with responsibilities and duties.
It seems too troublesome.
Until you become our president!  Dessert Club Member 1
We will not back down!  Dessert Club Member 2
How troublesome. Hmm...
Fine. I will be the president.
But there is a condition. Today is not the day, so wait for the next announcement.
Yes! We will wait, President!  Dessert Club Member 1
Let's just go home now.
...Theta?
Zzz... chew... meow...
Hey, Theta!
How are you going to be the president like this?
Just like that, I carried the sleeping Theta on my back and went home.
I almost threw my back out while bringing back the tent as well.
